token.title: 🔑 Lingbaiz GitHub
token.intro: Doiq aen dieggyaeq mbouj soengq lingbaiz, GitHub moix aen cungdaeuz dan dap 60 baez cingjgouz. Aen faex fork caezcienz aeu daihgaiq 32, ndigah baez daihngeih daeuj couh yungh liux. Miz lingbaiz, hanhdoh couh swng daengz moix aen cungdaeuz 5000.
token.step1: Hai Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, caiq Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner: gag aen zhanghauh mwngz. Expiration: ngoenz lawz cungj ndaej, aen faex mbouj aeu saek yiengh yungh nanz.
token.step4: Gij gienzhanh cungj mbouj yungh doengh. Meta cangzgu gunghgai mbouj aeu saek aen.
token.step5: Guh ok, caiq fukceih {token}. GitHub dan yienh baez ndeu.
token.classic: Lingbaiz gaeuq hix ndaej yungh: guh aen ndeu mbouj genj saek aen fanveiz. Fanveiz hoengq hix ndaej ciuq suzdu gaenq yinzcwng doeg soqgawq gunghgai.
token.stays: De yo youq ndaw liuzlanjgi neix, youq laj gienh {key}, dan soengq bae {host}. Yungjyuenj mbouj raiz haeuj diuz dieggyaeq, ndigah mwngz faen aen lienzciep dan daiq doz, mbouj daiq lingbaiz. Aen ceij youq laj gek raiz caeuq vanjcun caez cawz de.

token.proxy: caiq yungh {make} hainduj. Couh aen yungzgi raiz duenh nginx ndeu, dawz {header} nem daengz aen proxy {path}, ndigah liuzlanjgi dan heuh gag giz de, yungjyuenj mbouj ndaej lingbaiz. Aen gek raiz neix couh siu bae, boux daeuj yawj cungj caez yungh moix aen cungdaeuz 5000 baez.
